# getHistoricalGuideEntry

fun [getHistoricalGuideEntry](get-historical-guide-entry.html)(entryName: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), edition: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)): [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)

Retrieves an entry from The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy for a specific edition. This demonstrates relying on KDoc for schema extraction rather than @Param.

#### Return

A string containing the Guide's entry.

#### Parameters

 _entry Name_

The name of the entry (e.g. 'Babel Fish')

_edition_

The edition of the guide (e.g. 'Standard', 'Premium')
